'''Sadic's parents''' were two individuals who were [[Parent/Legends|parents]] of the future [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]],<ref name="Sadic" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]].<ref name="Model">Though not visible in-game due to his mask, [[Sadic]]'s character model in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' uses [[Human/Legends|Human]] textures, as can be seen here: {{WebCite|url=https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en/npc/lord-sadic|text=Lord Sadic|work=[https://swtor.jedipedia.net/en Jedipedia.net's SWTOR Database]|archivedate=20210123142300}}</ref> Considered to be low-class within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], they were essentially one step above [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] in Imperial society, though their son demonstrated [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] and was taken to the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] for [[Sith training|training]].<ref name="Sadic" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sadic's parents were mentioned in the Codex entry for Sadic in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Sadic" />
